text: This report reviews and recommends approval of a City-initiated amendment to the Zoning By-law in order to allow a concrete batching use. The site specific zoning by-law will allow for a concrete batching and mixing yard and the open storage of raw materials on the subject lands at 545 Commissioners Street.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend Zoning By-law 438-86 for the lands at 545 Commissioners Street substantially in accordance with the draft Zoning By-law Amendment attached as Attachment 1 to the supplementary report (March 23, 2018) from the Acting Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning. 2. City Council authorize the City Solicitor to make such stylistic and technical changes to the draft Zoning By-law Amendment as may be required. 3. City Council determine that no further notice is required in respect of the revised draft Site Specific Zoning Bylaw Amendment.
